desktop_workload.definition: Safari and ordinary background applications may remain open. Measure under that recorded desktop workload, kept approximately consistent across baseline and candidate trials.
desktop_workload.initial_user_context: User resumed Nov3 after explicit Nov2 pause. Record current desktop workload; ordinary apps/Safari may remain open. No apps or OS power settings changed by agent.
desktop_workload.known_change_handling: Record substantial known workload changes. Do not remove slow or paging-affected observations or silently relabel old strict data.
